name: Super Bock
verdict: Majority-held by the Violas family's VIACER with Carlsberg as the other large holder. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: privately held brewer — 56% Grupo VIACER (Violas group) and 44% Grupo Carlsberg (own site); Carlsberg's effective ownership 60% but it remains an associate, so no control, and neither owner is a state. Back-of-shirt sponsor at Porto and Sporting CP, official sponsor at Braga, 2026-27.
